how_to_apply: Download the application form provided in the official notification PDF.
Fill out the application form completely and attach your CV along with required supporting documents including degrees, mark sheets, and publications.
Email the duly filled application form, CV, and documents to [email protected] by 20/10/2026.

Indicate your preference of interview mode (online or offline) inside the email.

Alternatively, appear directly for the interview on 21/10/2026 at 12:30 PM in the Department of Biomedical Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Raipur, bringing the completed application form, CV, originals, and photocopies of all supporting documents.

content_sections.heading: NIT Raipur Junior Research Fellow at a Glance

rows.details: Investigating EEG and fNIRS signatures for different types of meditation - An Artificial Intelligence-based approach for evaluation and validation

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold a Graduate or Post graduate Degree in Electronics, Electronics and Telecommunication, Biomedical Engineering, Bioengineering, Medical Electronics, Biomedical Instrumentation, Signal Processing, and related fields. Applicants must be selected through a process described in either: Scholars selected through GATE and National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant professorship). Selection processes through National Level Examinations conducted by central Govt. Departments and their agencies and Institutions like IIT, IISc, DST, DBT, MHRD, etc. Desirable Qualification: Knowledge of basic programming skills in Python, MATLAB, C, C++. Understanding of EEG, signal processing techniques, machine learning and deep learning techniques/algorithms.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Junior Research Fellow will receive a fellowship amount of Rs. 31,000 per month plus 16% HRA. The position is purely temporary and continuation of the fellowship is subject to satisfactory performance, review, and availability of funds under the project. The appointment is co-terminus with the project, lasting up to 11 January 2027 only.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Raipur Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Download the application form provided in the official notification PDF. Fill out the application form completely and attach your CV along with required supporting documents including degrees, mark sheets, and publications. Email the duly filled application form, CV, and documents to [email protected] by 20/10/2026. Mark the email subject clearly as “Application for Junior Research Fellow (BME)” . Indicate your preference of interview mode (online or offline) inside the email. Alternatively, appear directly for the interview on 21/10/2026 at 12:30 PM in the Department of Biomedical Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Raipur, bringing the completed application form, CV, originals, and photocopies of all supporting documents.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is based on qualifications, eligibility, and an interview. The interview will be conducted on 21/10/2026 at 12:30 PM in the Department of Biomedical Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Raipur. Online interviews are permissible for candidates who submit their application online by the due date. No TA/DA is permissible for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is this Junior Research Fellow post permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: This position is purely temporary and contractual, running up to 11 January 2027 and co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid in addition to the monthly stipend?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates receive a fellowship of Rs. 31,000 per month plus 16% HRA.

faq.question: Q3. What must be written in the email subject line while applying?
faq.answer: Applicants must mark the email subject as “Application for Junior Research Fellow (BME)” and indicate their preference for online or offline interview modes.

faq.question: Q4. What are the desirable qualifications for this project?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include basic programming skills in Python, MATLAB, C, or C++, alongside an understanding of EEG, signal processing techniques, machine learning, and deep learning algorithms.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents need to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach a completed application form, CV, and photocopies of degrees, mark sheets, publications, and GATE/NET qualification proofs.
